FACEIT for MLBB: where to play serious 5v5 matches

There is no FACEIT for MLBB, but there are SKY, Lockin and MLBB Ladder: a queue, ELO, fixed roles and a game lobby. How they work and how to start.

In this story

  1. Why you need it
  2. SKY: the most detailed platform
  3. Lockin: Telegram sign-in and a strict check
  4. MLBB Ladder
  5. Tournaments with prizes
  6. Before your first match

In brief

  • FACEIT has no Mobile Legends. Fan-made platforms took its place for MLBB: SKY, Lockin and MLBB Ladder.
  • They all work the same way: a queue on the site, ten players of a similar level, roles set in advance, a custom lobby in the game and an ELO rating.
  • You need your own MLBB account: the platforms check the ID and server, and you can play only from it.
  • Playing is free. SKY promises cash prizes for the top of its leaderboard, and CyberHero by t2 runs tournaments with prizes.

Why you need it

MLBB ranked counts stars, and random matchmaking builds the team: your jungler may skip Retribution and two fighters may end up in one lane. Competitive platforms work differently. The rating is ELO, so it grows when you beat strong opponents. Roles are fixed before the match, and AFK or throwing games is punished. It is FACEIT, as in CS2, only for a mobile MOBA, which is why people search for "FACEIT for MLBB".

SKY: the most detailed platform

SKY was opened by the streamer Geass, and its beta started on 18 November 2026. It is a platform for 5v5 rated matches: everyone starts at zero ELO, the first ten matches are calibration, then come levels from 1 to 10. Results come from the game automatically: the win, damage, gold, KDA and MVP. The rating depends not only on your team's win but on your own contribution.

  1. Choose the preferred server with the lowest ping: each server has its own queue.
  2. Tick the roles you are ready to play and start the search.
  3. When a match is found, you have 45 seconds to accept. Missing it blocks the search: 2 minutes at first, longer for repeats the same day.
  4. The host creates a custom lobby from the link in the match card within 6 minutes, on the Mythic Battlefield map.
  5. Everyone else joins and takes their side, blue or red, as on the site.
  6. You play the role the site assigned. You can swap only if the player you swap with agrees.

Besides the regular mode there is a draft: two captains play rock-paper-scissors and pick players in turns, one for each role. It unlocks at 1531 ELO. There are also one-on-one duels with their own rating and class bans. Every finished match adds conduct points. Below 90 the search takes longer. A confirmed AFK costs 10 points, a violation 20.

Ping and rehost

A ping up to 60 ms counts as normal, and the match is played out. If it is higher, you can request a rehost in the first 2 minutes; it needs 7 votes out of 10. Surrendering instead of a rehost counts as a loss.

Playing is free. A three-tier Premium subscription gives cosmetics and conveniences and is paid in the in-house G-Coin currency, one G-Coin is one rouble. In its announcement SKY promises cash prizes for the top of the leaderboard, games with esports players, a pro league and mixes. Registration is from 14 years old.

Lockin: Telegram sign-in and a strict check

Lockin is made by enthusiasts who want points-based rating back, like the old PTS system. You sign in with one click through Telegram. The platform gets only your ID, name, username and profile photo, not your phone number or chats. The MLBB account is confirmed by ID and server, so smurfs will not get in.

  1. Sign in through Telegram.
  2. Enter your MLBB account ID and server.
  3. Pick a role: jungle, EXP, mid, gold or roam. You play it in the match, no lane arguments.
  4. Join the queue. The longer you wait, the wider the rating range of your opponents.
  5. Confirm you are ready and join the lobby from the link.

The ten players are split into teams with one per role so that the total rating of both sides is nearly equal. Beating stronger players gives more points. Matchmaking for full five-stacks is promised once there are enough players. On 26 November the leader of the table had 1574 points. The Lockin app is downloaded from their Telegram channel.

The link opens Google Play

If the lobby link opens the app store, hold it, copy it and paste it into the browser. If that fails, ask for the lobby code in the match chat. If the result has not arrived within a minute, press Call admin.

MLBB Ladder

MLBB Ladder is another fan-made 5v5 matchmaking. The site gathers ten players and splits them into two equal teams by ELO and role. There are levels from 1 to 10, seasons, tops by role and hero, profiles and match history. Sign-in needs no password, it goes through a Telegram bot. The site sits behind DDoS protection, so the browser sometimes asks you to pass a check first.

Tournaments with prizes

If you want money for results right now rather than a leaderboard, look at CyberHero by the operator t2. It runs one-on-one MLBB knockout tournaments almost every day. For example, on the weekend of 28 and 29 November 2026 there is the Solo Weekend Premium Cup with a prize pool of 10,000 roubles. The site is 18+.

Before your first match

  • Find your account ID and server: you will be asked for them at the check.
  • Decide which roles you are ready to play: the role is fixed before the match and you cannot leave it without consent.
  • Check your connection: on SKY a ping above 60 ms is already a reason for a rehost.
  • Play only from your own account. Every platform bans playing for someone else, and on SKY the account is bound for good.
  • Do not accept a match if you are not ready to finish it: missed matches lead to longer search blocks.

Frequently asked questions

Is there FACEIT for Mobile Legends?

FACEIT itself has no MLBB. A similar format comes from fan-made platforms SKY, Lockin and MLBB Ladder: a queue, ELO, roles and a lobby in the game.

How much does it cost to play?

Nothing. SKY has a paid Premium subscription, but it only gives cosmetics and conveniences.

Do I need a high rank?

No. Everyone starts from zero or with calibration, and the platform rating does not depend on your stars in the game. The captains draft on SKY unlocks at 1531 ELO.

Can I play with friends?

On SKY you can form a party of up to five. On Lockin matchmaking for ready teams is promised later.

Are the platforms connected to MOONTON?

No. All three are independent fan-made projects, and matches are played in the game's custom lobby.

Why does the lobby link not open?

Copy the link into the browser by hand or ask for the lobby code in the match chat. On SKY, if MLBB sent no link, the match is cancelled without a penalty.
